strategy.offer: Interior textiles for curtains, decoration, upholstery and related applications, including functional fabrics for residential and contract settings.
strategy.customers: Residential and commercial interior customers worldwide, including hospitality and other project environments needing aesthetic and performance textiles.
strategy.why_we_win: It believes clear, timeless design plus innovation, quality, functionality, product breadth and close customer collaboration create superior interior solutions.
strategy.resources: Its basis is a distinctive design tradition, creative development, 50 employees, international sales presence, and production partners delivering high-quality, durable fabrics.
strategy.direction: It is moving toward more sustainable operations and collections, increasing recycled and renewable materials while reducing waste, energy use and hard-to-recycle blends.
